summary: The Go SDK does not implement a retry loop for schedule updates when the server returns a 'mismatched conflict token' error, which occurs as of a recent server change. This requires SDK support to automatically retry schedule updates on conflict token mismatches.
userImpact: Users cannot update schedules when conflict token mismatches occur, requiring manual intervention until the SDK implements automatic retry logic.
rootCause: Server change (temporalio/temporal#8474) now returns 'mismatched conflict token' errors during schedule updates, but the Go SDK lacks automatic retry logic to handle this scenario.
proposedFix: Implement a conflict token retry loop for schedule update operations that automatically retries when conflict token mismatches are detected.
keyQuote: No SDK passes or retries on the conflict token for schedule updates. The server returns 'mismatched conflict token' as of https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/8474.
